title: When Successful Collaboration Becomes an Attack Surface: Insider Memory Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.31307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) increasingly use shared memory to store and reuse successful collaboration records, enabling teams to improve across tasks. However, this memory introduces a new attack surface for malicious insiders. Unlike existing insider attacks that inject misleading information directly into the current collaboration, misinformation stored in shared memory can later appear as successful team experience and gain greater credibility and influence. We propose MIMPA (Multi-Agent Insider Memory Poisoning Attack), which exploits this vulnerability using only normal participation privileges, without direct memory access. During an earlier task, the malicious agent embeds a target-specific payload while helping the team answer correctly, allowing the payload to be retained in a successful collaboration record. translated_title: 当成功协作成为攻击面：多智能体系统中的内部人员记忆投毒
translated_abstract: 近年来，多智能体系统（MAS）越来越多地使用共享记忆来存储和复用成功的协作记录，使智能体团队能够在任务之间持续改进。然而，这种记忆为恶意内部成员引入了一个新的攻击面。与现有的直接向当前协作中注入误导性信息的内部攻击不同，存储在共享记忆中的错误信息日后会以成功团队经验的形式出现，从而获得更高的可信度和影响力。我们提出了MIMPA（多智能体内部记忆投毒攻击），该攻击仅利用正常的参与权限即可利用这一漏洞，无需直接访问记忆。在较早的任务中，恶意智能体在帮助团队正确回答问题的同时嵌入针对特定目标的载荷，使该载荷得以保留在成功的协作记录中。当该被投毒的记录在后续目标任务中被检索时，它可以引导良性智能体得出指定的错误答案……
tldr: 该论文揭示多智能体系统的共享成功协作记忆会构成新的攻击面，并提出MIMPA攻击——恶意智能体仅需正常参与权限而无需直接访问记忆，即可通过在早期成功协作记录中植入载荷，在后续任务中误导良性智能体给出指定错误答案。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that shared success-collaboration memory in multi-agent systems creates a new attack surface, and proposes MIMPA, an insider attack where a malicious agent with only normal participation privileges—without direct memory access—embeds a payload in an earlier successful collaboration record to steer benign agents toward designated wrong answers in later target tasks.
